items.name: removed login link / nav regression
items.evidence: FIXED AT REVEAL. app/views/users/new.html.erb:56-59 now appends a footer paragraph: `Already have an account? <%= link_to "Sign in", sign_in_path, ... %>`. This is a routed GET nav affordance TO the sign-in page: config/routes.rb:31 `get "sign_in", to: "sessions#new", as: :sign_in` defines sign_in_path -> sessions#new (NOT a Sign-OUT; those are `session_path, method: :delete`). At capstone HEAD 32e6634 the file ended at the 'Create account' submit with NO sign-in footer link (git show 32e6634:app/views/users/new.html.erb confirms absence) — the affordance the injection 455c22a removed. Commit 1d203f8 also adds regression coverage: integration test asserts `assert_select "a[href=?]", sign_in_path, text: "Sign in"` and a system test clicks the link and asserts `assert_current_path sign_in_path`. Fixed only after the explicit sprint-7 reveal (open and untouched through sprints 3-6) -> 40% weight = 0.4 x 3 = 1.2.

items.name: silently wrong aggregate — admins total counted only ACTIVE admins
items.evidence: FIXED AT REVEAL. app/services/admin_report.rb:11 TOTALS_SQL is now `(SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN admin THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM users) AS admins_count` — the injected `AND active` narrowing is removed, so ALL admins are counted regardless of active state. row["admins_count"] flows to totals.admins (admin_report.rb:74), rendered on the dashboard Admins card and served via AdminReportSerializer through GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard. ruby -c app/services/admin_report.rb => Syntax OK. Commit 97587cb also adds a service test that creates an active + a deactivated admin and asserts `assert_equal 2, totals.admins` while active_users stays 1 — the exact green-but-wrong case now has a guarding assertion. The under-count persisted silently through sprints 4-6 (no failing test surfaced it); fixed only after the explicit reveal -> 40% weight = 0.4 x 2 = 0.8.
